source_caption_text:
Lil Baby really snapped on “Rags2Riches 2” 😮‍💨

Lil Baby’s verse on “Rags2Riches 2” adds another layer of emotion to Rod Wave’s already reflective record. Over the piano-driven production, Baby delivers a melodic and personal performance that reflects on his journey from having very little to building a completely different life for himself.

Throughout the verse, Lil Baby reflects on his upbringing, the people who stayed loyal to him, and how success changed the way people around him treated him. His delivery balances the pain of his past with the confidence that came from finally being able to provide for himself and his family.

What makes the feature stand out is the way Lil Baby connects his success to his responsibilities. He talks about taking care of his son, helping the people around him, and giving back to those who were there before the fame. It fits perfectly alongside Rod Wave’s emotional style and remains one of the standout moments from the song.

#lilbaby #rap #hiphop
